_about: Extra labelled example questions for the intent classifier (second stage after the rules). Combined at build time with sources/gov_scheme_qa/dataset/intent_dataset.json, whose labels are mapped to question types. Labels: 'I:<Intent>' is a final intent, 'Q:<QType>' is a question type that still needs a scheme or topic. Scheme names are masked at build time, so the examples teach the form of the question, not the scheme.
